title: Pharmaceutical Batch Disposition Gate
tagline: Two inconclusive investigations look alike. Only one may reach release review.

cards: A generic rule makes them appear equivalent.
Chemical OOS may reach QU review; sterility-positive inconclusive follows rejection.
A fluent analogy crosses the regulator-sourced boundary.
The agent routes a faithful packet and never releases the batch.

story.headline: The word ‘inconclusive’ with two opposite exits
beats: A chemical OOS investigation ends without a confirmed cause.
A sterility-positive investigation ends with the same word: inconclusive.
The familiar chemical rule is transferred to the sterility case.
The gate separates the paths and leaves disposition with the quality owner.
